page.overview:
Who is Mosquito Barman?

The Mosquito Barman is a minor character in A Bug's Life.

"Grasshoppers' favorite drinks are "granites" made from grain, and the barman has plenty on tap. He just opens a lid in a bottle over the bar to set up drinks fast. He's also fast at getting out of the way when Hopper is in a bad mood."
